current.text: He is a projected starter at forward next to Suggs, Bane, Franz Wagner and Carter. The team has a new head coach, Sean Sweeney, so roles may change.
Last season he took fewer shots, fewer mid-range shots and had lower usage. His assist rate and his share of assisted makes were career highs. His rim finishing is only around the 50th percentile.
He should be good for about 70 games this season.
In category leagues the experts see him as fair value in the 40s to mid 50s. He is not a sleeper in categories, and his market price is a little high for category leagues.
ESPN's rank of 75 is much too low for him. His Yahoo rank in the low 50s is a value, mainly in points leagues.
In an auction mock draft he sold for 19 USD.
Josh wanted to get him for under 20 USD.
He is eligible at F only. He does not have C eligibility.
Orlando is projected to win 47 or 48 games and finish as the 6th seed, which avoids the play-in.

durable.text: He is a much better points league player than a category league player. His value is highest in Yahoo points.

Experts say he gets too much hate in category leagues. In their view he does not kill the percentages, his blocks are about average and his steals are bad. His volume of points, rebounds and assists is strong.
Turnovers are his worst category. At about 3.1 per game, they are a league outlier on the weak side.
His assists are very high for a forward, and so are his points and rebounds.
His FT% is about 75% on about 8 attempts per game. That is weak for a forward and pulls down a team's FT%.
Josh says his free throw shooting has improved to a pretty good level.
He played through a groin strain last season.

tags.name: sites disagree on price
tags.detail: Yahoo value 19 USD and rank 52; ESPN value 5 USD and rank 75

note: His prices point to about 19 to 20 USD: Yahoo value 19, Yahoo average cost 18.8 and a 19 USD sale in a mock. The 26 USD our league paid last season would be an overpay in a category format, where experts rank him in the 40s to mid 50s. He fits punt TO and punt FT builds best because his strong points, rebounds and forward assists remain. Early in the season, check his shot volume and usage under new coach Sweeney, and whether his FT% holds near 75% or better.
